basic_profile.bio: I'm a long-time Redditor hailing from the Midwest, currently residing in Champaign, Illinois. I graduated from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign with a degree in Computer Science. My interests include gaming, especially Pixel Gun 3D, and I have a knack for UI/UX design. I'm passionate about sharing tips and tricks for games and often engage in discussions around educational content. When I'm not gaming, you can find me exploring local coffee shops or taking nature walks. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm currently single and work as a software developer for a tech startup.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a strong foundation in computer science from UIUC, I've honed my skills in software development and UI/UX design. My gaming expertise, particularly in Pixel Gun 3D, comes from years of playing and engaging with the community. I am constantly learning new strategies from forums and have a good grasp of the game's mechanics.
